name: OmniRDP
description: Continue RDPEGFX implementation from RDPEGFX_Implementation_Plan.md while obeying VIEWER_SERVER_REFACTOR_PLAN.md module boundaries. viewer_server.c must remain a high-level coordinator; canonical pixels belong in viewer_framebuffer, publishing/coalescing in viewer_publisher, RDPEGFX session/protocol sequencing in viewer_gfx_pipeline, and uncompressed payload construction in viewer_gfx_codec_uncompressed. GFX remains disabled by default until explicitly gated in a later story.

userStories.title: Finalize RDPEGFX lifecycle and caps seam
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the existing RDPEGFX lifecycle and capability negotiation extraction verified and kept behind narrow pipeline APIs so that viewer_server.c remains a high-level coordinator without hidden singleton orchestration callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer_gfx_pipeline owns RdpgfxServerContext create/free/init/uninit/open and CapsAdvertise/CapsConfirm mechanics.
viewer_server.c does not construct CapsConfirm PDUs or choose caps directly, and explicitly performs server-owned fallback/join orchestration from pipeline result flags.
Frame acknowledgement remains in viewer_server.c for this story.
Viewer and backend GFX remain disabled by default.
clang-format is run on modified C/H files if any.

Debug build passes, or missing local dependency blocker is documented.
ctest/tests pass, or unavailable tests are documented with the reason.
userStories.notes: Re-verification/finalization completed: Debug build and ctest passed, and oracle review accepted the lifecycle/caps seam. Do not broaden into reset/create/map/full-frame activation, frame ACK migration, framebuffer routing, publisher policy, or codec behavior. Orchestrator coordinates stories/progress; the bounded fixer/Ralph implementation agent may edit code/tests/CMake for future stories.

userStories.title: Document and test framebuffer invariants
userStories.description: As a developer, I want canonical framebuffer format, stride, generation, dirty-region, and snapshot ownership invariants documented and tested so that later publisher and GFX stories have a reliable pixel source.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover resize, pixel update, dirty rect accumulation, overflow behavior, snapshot/free ownership, and generation increments.
The canonical pixel format and stride/orientation assumptions are documented in code comments or Markdown.
viewer_framebuffer.c/.h contains no FreeRDP send calls and no RdpgfxServerContext references.
No live viewer traffic is routed through the framebuffer in this story.

userStories.notes: Completed: framebuffer invariants documented; mark-dirty accumulation/overflow, snapshot_free reset behavior, and generation non-increment on mark_dirty are covered by tests. Debug build, ctest, clang-format, and git diff --check passed. Do not change viewer delivery behavior in this story.

userStories.title: Feed framebuffer from decoded GDI pixels
userStories.description: As a developer, I want backend decoded FreeRDP/GDI pixels copied into the canonical framebuffer after updates are processed so that both classic and future GFX viewers can publish from the same latest-state pixel source.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend classic updates result in canonical framebuffer pixel and generation changes.
Dirty rectangles are bounded and validated before framebuffer update.
viewer_framebuffer remains independent from FreeRDP send APIs and RDPEGFX session state.
Backend RDPEGFX PDU payload replay is not made authoritative for canonical pixels.
Viewer and backend GFX remain disabled by default.

userStories.notes: Completed: decoded GDI framebuffer ingestion now validates dirty rectangles before canonical framebuffer update; invalid/out-of-bounds dirty rects are dropped, and if none remain the update falls back to full-frame dirty for correctness. Debug build, ctest, clang-format, JSON validation, and git diff --check passed. Do not enable backend GFX in this story. Existing backend-PDU replay/ring code remains transitional in viewer_server.c and must not be mixed into the canonical framebuffer/publisher source of truth.

viewer_server.c only calls narrow publisher APIs and does not gain dirty-region or backlog algorithms.
viewer_publisher contains no RdpgfxServerContext ownership or direct RDPEGFX session state.

acceptanceCriteria: Late classic viewer receives a current full-frame baseline from framebuffer before incremental updates.

userStories.title: Coalesce classic delivery to latest framebuffer state

acceptanceCriteria: Slow viewer backlog is bounded by update count and/or queued bytes.
Coalesced dirty regions converge each viewer to the latest framebuffer generation.
One slow viewer does not block backend decode or other viewers.
Tests cover generation advancement, stale drop/coalesce behavior, and queue limits.
No RDPEGFX send behavior is introduced.
